summary: BILI Social International, Inc. filed an 8-K on June 11, 2026, reporting that its Board increased directorships from three to six and appointed three new independent directors (Fotheringham, Jiao, Muamba) to fill vacancies. No departures or officer changes were disclosed; the appointments appear routine board expansion. No terms, advisors, or structural mechanics are provided. The event is board-composition adjustment rather than a forced/abrupt departure, making this a borderline special situation. What to watch: whether new directors signal future strategic actions.
